patches.name: Home and Work shortcuts
patches.description: Adds Home and Work shortcut chips beside Maps' category carousel, with clean Back navigation. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places, which draws saved places, labels and starred places on the map. Built for bearinmind 2.5.5 and Maps 26.36.04.973607363. Does not support Add microG support.

patches.name: Label search suggestions
patches.description: While you type in Maps' search box, shows up to three matching Home, Work and Local saved labels above Google's suggestions (exact, then prefix, then substring; case and accents ignored). Tap one to open the place, or in directions to set the stop being edited. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places. Built for bearinmind 2.5.5 and Maps 26.36.04.973607363. Does not support Add microG support.
